summary: Clearmind Medicine filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release providing an update from a June 10 webinar on its ongoing Phase I/IIa first-in-human trial of CMND-100, a non-hallucinogenic MEAI compound for alcohol use disorder. No terms, prices, premiums, or dates were disclosed. The filing is a routine business update on clinical trial progress with no special-situation event. It carries no board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics. As a non-US issuer report equivalent to a voluntary current report, the disclosure does not trigger any merger, tender, restructuring, or similar category.
